tenderSchedule.title: Providing Manpower Services on outsource basis for the Department of Collegiate Education, Bangalore
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Manpower services on outsource basis for the Department of Collegiate Education, Bangalore

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Department of Collegiate Education, Unnatha Shikshana Soudha, Sheshadri Road, Bangalore-1

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and condtions as per Tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Legal Status and Registration: The bidder shall be a duly registered/incorporated entity and shall possess PAN, TAN and valid signatory authorisation. Joint ventures and reliance on another entity's credentials are not permitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- relevant documents as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Relevant Experience: The bidder shall have a minimum of 3 completed years of actual manpower-service operations as on the bid submission deadline.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Value of Manpower Services Executed: The bidder shall have satisfactorily executed eligible manpower services valued at not less than Rs.32.8 crore in any one of the FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 or FY 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Manpower Deployment Capacity: The bidder shall have deployed at least 800 distinct personnel in any one of FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 or FY 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Statutory Compliance: The bidder shall possess applicable labour registration/licence or equivalent authorisation recognised by the competent authority, and EPF, ESI, GST and Professional Tax registrations, wherever applicable. A contract-specific licence shall be obtained before deployment wherever legally required.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Financial Capacty and Contractual Acceptance: The bidder shall have adequate financial capacity to pay wages and statutory dues within lawful due dates, irrespective of reimbursement by the Department, and shall accept the wage, safety, attendance and reporting requirements without material deviation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: ISO Certification: The bidder shall possess a valid ISO 9001:2026 or ISO 9001:2015 certification, as applicable, covering manpower supply, staffing, outsourcing or related manpower management services.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Annual Turnover: The bidder shall have an average annual turnover of at least Rs.41 crore during FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Positive Net Worth: The bidder shall have positive net worth in each of the three financial years, FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: No Litigations/Debarment: The bidder shall have no subsisting debarment/blacklisting by any Government department or public sector entity and shall disclose material contract terminations, litigation and statutory proceedings.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bangalore Office: The bidder shall have a Bengaluru coordination office or undertake to establish one before commencement of services.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Document as per RFP

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All Other necessary documents as per RFP
